title: Screen Vision MCP Server - Tool Manifest
description: On-demand screen access, interaction, and UI Automation for agents via MCP. Runs locally. Two accuracy paths: OCR+geometry (any app, ~3-4s) and Windows UI Automation (native apps + Chromium, ground truth, <200ms). A flow engine encodes the look->act->verify loop; a JSONL audit log records every control action.

tool_groups.notes: expect_window parameter aborts control tools when the active window title changes (focus-guard against the classic mis-typed-into-wrong-window failure).

design_rules: No tool runs unless explicitly called by the agent interacting with the user.
No network access: frames, profiles, and the audit log stay on disk.
Watcher stores at most 12 recent frames and recycles them.
Every interaction is logged to control_log.jsonl.
run_flow aborts on first failing step; the 'alerts' op catches error dialogs before Enter is pressed.
Autonomy: 'demo' mode requires confirm:true for submit-like presses; 'full' acts without per-step confirmation.

success_criteria_v2.repeatable_flows: declarative run_flow instead of re-derived prompts
